According to the IT policy "PASSWORD AND DEVICE SECURITY POLICY" [1], the password policy for the organization requires that all corporate account passwords must be a minimum of 14 characters and include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character. Passwords must be changed every 180 days and reuse of the last 10 passwords is not permitted. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all accounts accessing email, VPN, or SharePoint.

The policy also requires the use of strong, unique passwords and multi-factor authentication on all Company accounts [3]. Additionally, it prohibits sharing credentials or allowing others to use your account or device, and requires the installation of only approved software and keeping devices updated and encrypted.

Therefore, the password policy for the organization is to use strong, unique passwords that are changed regularly and require multi-factor authentication for accessing certain Company accounts.
